result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but the promotional banner has a clear readability problem and some horizontally scrollable content is visibly cut off at the right edge.

issues.description: The white headline and subtitle in the pale green promotional banner have very low contrast against the background, making the offer difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a substantially darker text color, darken the banner background, or add a stronger opaque overlay behind the promotional copy to meet contrast requirements.

issues.description: The category row and "Fastest near you" carousel are clipped at the right screen edge, leaving a partial category pill and partial restaurant card/title visible. This may be intended as a horizontal-scroll cue, but it looks abrupt and makes the content feel truncated.
issues.suggestion: Make the horizontal-scroll affordance clearer with consistent card spacing and/or a fade/peek treatment; ensure clipped titles are ellipsized or otherwise handled cleanly.
